panels.name: Grim Guzzler — upper floor and rear exit

markers.to: 01:II ↔ 03:I; upper crossing to West Garrison, enabled by Shadowforge Lock
03:I ↔ 03:II; Manufactory bridge to Grim Guzzler lower floor
03:III ↔ 04:I; event-dependent rear exit to western Shadowforge City

uncertain: Garrison ramps, the Manufactory bridge and the exact tavern stair footprint are unverified; dashed corridors preserve the documented connections only.
Tavern object positions and room proportions are approximate.
The storeroom is documented, but its detailed shape and entrance alignment are uncertain.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
Angerforge is a descending side trip; return to the landing to continue into the Manufactory.
The bar’s rear exit is on the upper level. Rocknot’s event is one way to open it and activate Phalanx. Alternative exit methods are not separate doors.
Hurley and Ribbly are lower-floor optional encounters; Plugger and Phalanx are upstairs. The numbering is a full-clear convention, not a requirement to kill friendly vendors.
J is the same internal stair connection at both ends.
Coren Direbrew and later transport devices are excluded from this Vanilla map.
